profile_text: Security services in Düsseldorf, Germany are being driven by A.C.P. SECURITY & SERVICE GMBH, a company that has experienced a 273.7% growth since its baseline, now employing 71 people in 2024. This growth is attributed to the increasing demand for specialized security and related services in the region. As a scaler in the administrative and support service activities sector, the company's focused approach has enabled it to expand rapidly and establish a strong presence in the market.
